Title: Garden Bloom Thinkers — Set of 3
Body (HTML):
A set of three seated “thinker” figures cast in clear resin and filled with real flowers — picked and dried in the artist's own garden. Cornflower blue and deep magenta petals drift through each translucent body, so the light comes through them like stained glass. Every flower was grown, picked and dried by hand, then placed petal by petal inside the mould before pouring — the most painstaking piece in the collection.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Moonstone Thinkers — Set of 3
